title: Mine Shaft Access Bay with Rail Arch and Vein Wall
description: One static mine shaft access bay scene, one scene and zero new independent models. Four complete original assets at unit scale retain all47 original meshes,3074 oriented triangles and per-face opaque solid PBR values: fixed grooved-sheave headframe on the right, three-piece channel arch over one complete2m surface track on the left, and continuous mineral-vein rock wall behind the open bay. Only declared translations and safe name prefixes; no old part extraction, scaling or recoloring. One additional scene-only closed earth support slab has a genuine through-aperture under the whole original shaft-mouth collar, enlarged by2mm per side beneath its thick rim; no floor cap blocks the shaft opening. Total48meshes3138triangles15materials. This is not the previous ore-screen/hopper siding and adds no independent model. The short surface rail has open ends and does not connect to an underground route or a shaft cage. No mine tunnel, enclosure, hoisting cable, ore flow, workers, actual mining operation, navigation, access or fall protection, structural bearing, installation or safety claim. Preview ground is not an asset shaft bottom; no underground depth is represented.
